note: Daniel Boone National Forest campground on a wooded ridge above Laurel River Lake, near Grove Boat Ramp and Marina; no swimming beach (the Corps runs one at the dam). Three loops under full forest canopy. Duff Branch, Spruce Creek, Fishing Point, Singing Hills and Oak Branch trails start in the campground. Separate from the Grove boat-in campground. --Claude
summary: Kept. Fees $46 confirmed (doubles $92). 50 electric sites (rec.gov; FS page says 40), 30A + water, max 50 ft; sewer not supported - dropped. Facilities + dump. Season 04-09..10-10 (new; FS page Apr 15-Oct 5). Only loop B reservable (fcfs some_sites), weekend 2 / holiday 3 minimums, max stay 14. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin OK.
